CustomObject.description: Runtime configuration for the nightly receivables sync (FSD 5.9.6). Holds the kill switch, the pluggable provider class name, the health-check tolerances and the Case-opening thresholds. Read via getOrgDefaults() - zero SOQL, same as SharePoint_Config__c. NO HARDCODED FALLBACK IS PERMITTED IN APEX: if the org-default row is missing or Is_Enabled__c is false, the run must log a Sync_Run__c with Halt_Reason__c = Disabled and do nothing. Custom Setting DATA is not deployable - the org-default row is a post-deploy Setup step.
CustomObject.label: Receivables Sync Config
